title: auto-dao session state
description: Authoritative session state for a learning session. All other Markdown status files are derived views.

topic_name.description: Human-readable display name of the topic (may include Chinese or non-ASCII chars)

source_path.description: Path to the original learning material

processed_path.description: Path to the Markdown-converted material (empty if source is already Markdown)

source_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the source file, used to detect material changes

current_lesson.description: Next lesson to generate or current lesson in progress

total_lessons.description: Planned total number of lessons from roadmap

last_completed_lesson.description: Index of the last fully graded lesson

mastery_passed.description: Cumulative count of correctly answered questions

mastery_failed.description: Cumulative count of incorrectly answered questions

counterfactual_mode.description: Counterfactual reasoning mode. null = not yet decided (will prompt user)

learning_language.description: ISO 639-1 code for the teaching language, e.g. 'zh', 'en'. Empty = same as material language

wait_reason.description: Why the session is blocked, null when not blocked

wait_detail.description: Optional human-readable blocking details. Keep wait_reason machine-stable and put lesson-specific context here.

repo_commit_hash.description: Git commit hash of the repository at learning time. Used for incremental learning on revisit. null for non-repo sources.

current_mode.description: Current lesson generation mode. New sessions start with learn. core is retained only for legacy session compatibility.

lesson_files_learn.description: Ordered learner-facing learn-card filenames stored under lessons/learn/. New lesson generation writes here first.

lesson_files_practice.description: Ordered practice-pack filenames stored under lessons/practice/. Generated after or alongside learn cards when practice is needed.

lesson_files_core.description: Legacy ordered core lesson filenames stored under lessons/. New sessions should not append to this list. Transitional nulls are allowed for legacy in-progress sessions.

lesson_files_deep.description: Ordered deep lesson filenames stored under lessons/. New lesson generation writes here. Transitional nulls are allowed for legacy in-progress sessions.

mode_switch_log.description: Audit trail for switching among learn, practice, deep, and legacy core modes.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last state update

learner_model.description: Dynamic learner model — updated after each diagnostic, lesson, and review cycle

schema_version.description: Internal learner_model schema version (independent of the outer session schema_version)

lesson_index.description: Lesson where this concept was taught

confidence_bias.description: Pattern: high confidence + poor results = overconfident

overall_confidence_bias.description: Aggregated confidence bias across all recent assessments

preferred_pace.description: Inferred from lesson completion speed and remediation frequency

bloom_target.description: Current target Bloom level (may be lowered by Step 3.5连续补救课后自动下调)

_file_paths.description: Logical name to actual filename mapping for all session-level files. Allows renaming without breaking AI references.

lesson_titles.description: Ordered titles of all planned lessons in the roadmap (display-friendly names)

lesson_files.description: Ordered filenames of lessons aligned with lesson_titles (stored under lessons/)

lesson_variants.description: Maps lesson id (e.g. '02.1') to variant metadata. Used when a lesson was regenerated with a newer template (e.g. v1 -> v2). Introduced by 2026-04-18 scenario-closure-feynman-design.

active.description: Currently active lesson file (the one students should read)

legacy.description: Archived older versions of this lesson

teaching_mode.description: A = knowledge-structure oriented (single scenario); B = scenario-closure oriented (>=2 independent scenarios)

scenario_closures.description: List of closure names; required when teaching_mode='B'

notes_dir.description: Relative path to the per-lesson notes directory (holds my_notes.md + photos/ + exercises/)

regenerated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this variant became active

regeneration_reason.description: Human-readable reason for regeneration (e.g. template upgrade, mastery failure postmortem)

reset_log.description: Audit trail of session-level resets (topic restructure, lesson regeneration, roadmap changes)
